post_title: Hollow Knight Costs You 56¢ an Hour. Worth It?
post_caption:
Hollow Knight is $14.99 on Steam and takes about 27 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat main story): 56 cents an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (about 66 hours) and it drops to 23 cents an hour. Our own math.
Is Hollow Knight still worth it in 2026?
